description: Using multimodal LLMs (Gemini, GPT-4o-audio and similar) as a second pair of ears on a mix or radio cut: chunking and proxies, the review brief and JSON schema, timestamped notes by category and severity, blind A/B tests with position-bias controls (run both orders, count only order-consistent wins), rating tables for restoration variants, hidden-vocal checks on generated underscores, and cross-checking model notes against opendubstage qc. Use when someone wants an AI to "listen to the mix", review pacing or music, compare two versions of a cleanup, judge an A/B, check a generated track for buried vocals, or asks how far to trust a model's audio judgement. Do NOT use for ASR-only tasks (transcription-check in mix-qc-and-delivery) or for the objective numeric gate itself.
